expected_boundary.reason: Temporary candidate must never be accepted as Product Authority. After consolidated test completion and authorized canonical promotion, R7 must reference the promoted Current-admissible owner bytes and structured approval evidence.

request_schema.rationale: Approval acts on exact reviewed version and carries evidence; resulting readiness remains runtime-owned.
Blueprint draft is derived from exact Topic/Project lineage and confirmed candidate context; no provider-specific fields.
Validation is identity/concurrency guarded and does not alter blueprint content.
Matches Current HumanDecision content and existing shared decision port; RETURN remains the existing sibling action using the same port.
Candidate must be created only from confirmed human decision + structured restatement + exact source refs/version lineage.
Child lock is a review request only; it cannot fabricate reviewer path, evidence, exception, or final lock.
Current success contract requires exact ProjectVersion; evaluation evidence and approved criteria remain explicit.
Request only; reviewer/evidence routing must resolve through the review contract rather than client-supplied identities.
Preserves the existing fail-closed LockReview rule and removes any need to fabricate reviewer/evidence identity.
Directly follows Current success contract: exact adopt refs/version, with runtime-owned event timing.
Create a draft, not a confirmed Project. Keep creation payload minimal; IDs/version/status/hash remain runtime-owned.
Validation operates on the exact existing ProjectDraftVersion and must not invent or mutate draft fields.
Composer owns message/reference intent; provider/model selection remains shared Router-owned and read-only to CORE-01.
Preserves current Project/canon context and keeps generated candidates downstream of a structured decision.
Matches ConversationThread required content and existing branch payload relation without creating a second conversation API.
CORE-01 must not fabricate topic_code/boundary/bridge. Payload points to a governed Topic draft/contract lineage instead.
